The function requires fields: day, current_city, transportation, breakfast, attraction, lunch, dinner, accommodation. We need to fill each. For days where traveling between cities, we indicate "from A to B". For transportation string, we need to include flight or bus? Probably car rental? We can assume driving. So transportation: "Car Rental, Washington -> Indianapolis" etc. Provide details. Breakfast, lunch, dinner: restaurants. Attractio: list separated by semicolon. Accommodation: name of hotel. Use "-" if not applicable. Since we have 3 cities, we can allocate 3 days per city? 7 days: Day1: Depart Washington to Indianapolis. Day2-3: Indianapolis. Day4: Travel to Bloomington? Day4-5: Bloomington. Day6: Travel to Evansville. Day6-7: Evansville. Then Day7: return? Actually 7 days includes departure day and return day? The dates March 23-29 inclusive is 7 days. So maybe Day1: March 23: depart Washington to Indianapolis (arrive same day). Day2: March 24: Indianapolis. Day3: March 25: Indianapolis. Day4: March 26: Travel to Bloomington. Day5: March 27: Bloomington. Day6: March 28: Travel to Evansville. Day7: March 29: Evansville and return to Washington? But if return same day maybe okay. Let's keep Day7 as Evansville with travel back to Washington? But we need only 7 days. We can assume return on Day7 after day activities.

We need accommodations suitable for children under 10. Use family-friendly hotels. Let's pick: Day1-3: Holiday Inn Express Indianapolis Downtown. Day4-5: Residence Inn Bloomington. Day6-7: Holiday Inn Evansville Downtown.

Breakfast: choose local breakfast spots. Attractio: list of attractions with semicolons. Provide lunch and dinner restaurants.

Transportation: For each day, we include vehicle details. For travel days, we can have "Car Rental: Washington to Indianapolis, Departure Time: 08:00, Arrival Time: 12:00" etc. For each day, we provide transportation. For days staying, we can say "Car Rental, Local".

We must call submit_day_plan per day. Must include "day" numeric. Must include "current_city". Transportation string. breakfast, attraction, lunch, dinner, accommodation. Use "-" if not applicable.

breakfast.description: The name of a restaurant in the city, e.g. "Nagaland's Kitchen, Charlotte"

attraction.description: Use a ";" to separate different attractions, with each attraction formatted as "Name, City". e.g. "The Charlotte Museum of History, Charlotte;"

accommodation.description: e.g. "Affordable Spacious Refurbished Room in Bushwick!, Charlotte"
